title: ShulkerPicker
description:
Middle click Get the block
Even if its buried inside a shulker box
body:
Upgrade your pick block.
This mod lets you middle-click blocks and automatically pull them from shulker boxes in your inventory.

No more opening boxes or searching for items—just look at a block, press pick block, and it’s instantly in your hotbar. Works seamlessly with vanilla behavior and keeps building fast and smooth.
